result.instructions: Tools for Oblio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices from this month have not been collected yet?"; "Show invoices issued to client Acme SRL since January."; "Which document series do I have and what is the next number in each?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Oblio data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run oblio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oblio_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oblio_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. oblio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oblio_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: The companies (CIF, name, your access level) linked to the connected Oblio account. Good first call: every other tool needs a CIF from here. GET /api/nomenclature/companies.

tools.title: List VAT rates
tools.description: VAT rates (name, percent, default) of a company; use the name and percent on document lines. GET /api/nomenclature/vat_rates.

tools.name: oblio_create_proforma
tools.title: Create a proforma
tools.description: Create a PROFORMA (not a fiscal invoice; the preferred first step). It takes the next number of the series immediately, there is no draft state, and Oblio sends no e-mail. Check client, lines, VAT (oblio_list_vat_rates) and series (oblio_list_series) first. Returns the series, number and a PDF link. Not retried: if the reply is an error, look in Oblio before repeating. POST /api/docs/proforma.

tools.name: oblio_issue_invoice
tools.title: Issue an invoice (fiscal, irreversible)
tools.description: ISSUE a real INVOICE. This is a legal fiscal document: it takes the next number in the series at once, there is no draft state, it cannot be edited, and it can only be cancelled afterwards (it may also be sent to ANAF e-Factura / SPV, automatically if the account is set up so). Needs confirm: true, an idempotency_key, and the user's explicit approval of the exact client, lines, totals and series. Optionally base it on a proforma or notice (reference_document), record the payment at once (collect) or set the delivery date. Not retried: if the reply is an error, look in Oblio before repeating. Oblio never e-mails the client from this tool. POST /api/docs/invoice.

tools.name: oblio_send_einvoice_to_spv
tools.title: Send an invoice to e-Factura (SPV)
tools.description: SEND an issued invoice to ANAF e-Factura (SPV). Irreversible: a document accepted by ANAF cannot be withdrawn from this API. Needs confirm: true and the user's approval. tools.name: oblio_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Subscribe an HTTPS endpoint to an Oblio event (stock changes, drafts/updates/cancellations of documents, collections). Oblio will POST account data to that URL, so only use an endpoint the user named and controls; it must answer 200 with the base64 of the X-Oblio-Request-Id header. Needs confirm: true. POST /api/webhooks.
